args.content:
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: self-hosted
    strategy:
      matrix:
        node-version: [ '22', '24' ]
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Run tests
        run: npm test
        env:
          NODE_VERSION: ${{ matrix.node-version }}

input.thought: Created a GitHub Actions workflow file to run tests on Node 22 and 24 on the test runner pool.

args.content:
## Continuous Integration

We use GitHub Actions for continuous integration. Our CI jobs run on the self-hosted runner pools described in [docs/RUNNERS.md](docs/RUNNERS.md).

### Test Job

The test job runs on the test runner pool and uses Node.js 22 and 24 for testing.
